diagnostic_candidate.reason: Repeated destination walk after ringlap belongs to an accepted active A normal write and first lookup miss. Its source has fully returned before this necessary translation and normal response complete; first destination DDR AW follows the response, with last B and parent DONE later. PTE local/DS/selector/DDR identity is retained. AW demux stalls are separate context and not a requirement or sole-cause attribution. This establishes necessary write-translation chain, not saved time or predicted performance.
